name: systole
description: Systole — a single-file cardiology board-review app built by patching a personal ACCSAP 12 export. The question bank itself is licensed content and is never committed.

comments.dependencies: The build has none on purpose — it is Node's standard library and 64 patch scripts. Playwright is needed only to run the test suites and is expected globally (npm i -g playwright && npx playwright install chromium), so a plain build never has to install a browser.
comments.usage: npm run build -- path/to/ACCSAP_export.html   then   npm test
